[Erowid Note: 
The term "acid" has been used as a common name for d-LSD since the 1960s. Although confusion associated with newer psychoactive substances has lead some people to use the term "acid" to refer to anything LSD-like or anything psychedelic on blotter or sold in drops, we believe this represents an error and not a useful evolution in language.]
Last night I decided to take a tab and a half of 1p-lsd. It was stupid because during the day I had woken up at 7 worked out and then worked from 9 to 6 and took the dose at like 8:55. When I took it I was already tired but I didnt think it was going to be a crazy experience... and I realize now how I disrespected such a powerful substance (hopefully this wasnt a bad trip).
So the acid kicks in at about 9:45-9:55 and personally I dont like the come up because I feel uncomfortable and to be honest kind of depressed sometimes. So I watched some stupid freak out videos on YouTube until I felt great (thats usually at the 1:30-2h mark). After I got done with the bad part of the trip I put on my headphones. I laid in my bed for at least 2 hours just listening to music and enjoying the closed eyes visuals. Then I decided to go outside on my balcony and the sky was so beautifulit looked like the clouds were purple and behind the cloud I could see the universe. I probably spent like 30 minutes sitting on my balcony because when I went back to my room it was about midnight. Then I played videogames and watched videos until 4.
And heres when the interesting (to say the least) part happened. I decided to go to sleep even tho I was still tripping pretty hard. I managed to fall asleep. My dream was so incredibly vivid.
My dream was so incredibly vivid.
The Dream: I was in my memories walking around and I could see that everything that I did had a profound impact on the future even things that I would have never think were related. And the crazy part was I could rewind each memory and see not only where it started but I could see what other events caused it. I kept walking around and looking at memories like they were movies it was so niceI could even see things that were in the future but I couldnt play those they were just like a moment I was in but everything was staying still. After a while I came across these beings that bought me in these place where there was all these barcodes and every code was a life so they told me to choose 1. I did and then they told me the date of my deathDecember 17 2066 and said see you in 3 minutes. I dont remember living the life. I was then in the last moment of this life, about to die and I was so afraid of what was coming I just started shaking and screaming like never before when all of the sudden everything went black but I wasnt scared anymore. I felt like the happiest I ever felt not because I was dead but because I realized how beautiful but fast of an experience life was. I woke upin my bed realizing how I shouldnt be afraid of death but instead live my life in a way that I dont regret anything when that moment comes.
And here I am, writing about my experience on the internet. You know its my first time ever writing about 1 of my trips but this one was special.
